verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a single hands-on community report that a manager built a backend in n8n with "scheduled and webhook-initiated tasks". That suggests n8n itself can trigger workflows on a schedule, but nothing confirms cron expressions or recurring cadence options. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of a schedule/cron trigger, evidence of cron-expression syntax, evidence of timezone configuration (per-workflow or instance-level), and confirmation of recurring versus one-off scheduling.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can run workflows on cron-style schedules with timezone control

citations.quote: Our manager with zero programming skills was able to build a quite complex backend using postgres and REST APIs, with scheduled and webhook-initiated tasks.
